name: OpenVibe.Coupons

site.name: Coupons
site.what: Coupon codes with merchant matching, restrictions, expiry and real-people validity reports.
site.description: OpenVibe.Coupons is community-checked coupon discovery: codes matched to stores, validity reported by real people, expirations tracked, and a browser helper on the way.

pillars.title: The right shop
pillars.text: Each shop lists the domains and paths it covers, so a code is matched to the site you are on.

pillars.title: Restrictions stated
pillars.text: Minimum spend, new customers only, the products it applies to: written down, not hidden.

pillars.title: Honest expiry
pillars.text: An expiry date when there is one, and "unknown" when there is not.

pillars.title: Reports from people
pillars.text: Worked or did not work, recently: the status comes from what people said when they tried it.

site.keywords: openvibe coupons, coupon codes, community coupons
site.launch: a person to verify a coupons source's terms and switch it on

meanwhile.label: Deals
meanwhile.note: Deal discovery is the sibling of this room.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

resumes.what: the expiry sweep records codes whose expiry passed during the stop (active lists filter on expires_at anyway)
the OpenVibe.Sources change feed is pulled again from the stored cursor, so items published during the stop arrive (idempotent per item revision)
unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

leases.none: no claims: one process owns the ov_coupons PostgreSQL database; writes are transactions there

notes: Port 4850. Owns coupon_merchants, coupon_merchant_domains, coupons, coupon_sources, coupon_restrictions, coupon_validation_reports, coupon_status_history, coupon_application_hints, coupon_watches in its own PostgreSQL database (ov_coupons), plus extension_installs (cpx_ browser-helper tokens, scopes coupons.lookup and coupons.report, hashed, revocable). Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO, JWKS) and OpenVibe.Sources (sources.item.read, category coupons); publishes through OpenVibe.Events (events.event.publish); OpenVibe.Search reads coupons.index_document.* from Events. The browser helper lives in OpenVibers/OpenVibe.Extensions (ADR-023).
